This mod is a modification of Suushiico's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23905?tab=description]Junimos as Farm Animals[/url]﻿ mod. 
The animations are changed, and the colours are more vibrant to match the vanilla Junimo's and Junimo plushes.
Modified with permission "This mod is no longer being maintained. I give anyone
permission to build upon any of my Stardew Valley mods"




[img]https://i.imgur.com/FGalk28.png[/img]

This mod adds Junimo as a livestock option that are purchasable from Marnie's Ranch.
The Junimo will drop seasonal crops at random. There are 10 Junimo colours to collect!

You can purchase specific colours, or using GMCM you can enable random colours.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/KCilBwk.png[/img]

﻿[b]1[/b]. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[b]2[/b]. Download the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿
[b]3[/b]. Download the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]
[b]4[/b]. Download Jeelh's Junimo Livestock
[b]5[/b]. Extract into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder
[b]6[/b]. Launch the game go to Marnie's to purchase your Junimo
